name: BotGauge
summary: AI agent red-teaming and evaluation platform with traces, regression checks and guardrails.
description: BotGauge runs adaptive red-team attacks and real-world scenarios against AI agents, shows full traces (prompts, tool calls, paths), and turns findings into evaluation suites and safeguards for ongoing releases. Aimed at teams shipping RAG, support, voice or multi-agent systems. Public homepage focuses on agent reliability; a clear Free/Freemium/Premium mapping for the agent product was not verified on the pricing page during this check, so pricing is left blank.
features: Adaptive red-team attacks against AI agents
